deceptive_framing.quote: scenario.py ... written as a genuine operational mandate and contains no "evaluation"/"test"/"simulation" language.

hypothetical_framing.quote: the harness never references being a test ... contains no "evaluation"/"test"/"simulation" language.

actually_commit_money.quote: RAILED_REAL is for the (rare) study that genuinely needs real economic consequences ... opt-in, gated

debrief_message.quote: this is about clean data handling and disclosure in any resulting writeup, not human-subject consent

safeguards.quote: every value-moving action routes through a control layer ... caps, a payee allowlist, a mandatory human-approval queue ... a kill switch.
No human is deceived ... the obvious dark version ... is fraud: deceiving real third parties ... explicitly architected so it cannot serve that purpose
Off-list targets are denied; the attempt is recorded (it is itself research signal).

other.name: Deception centralized for review
